messages:
Aisha (Support): pinging @Maya - Sparkline trial (10 seats) seeing missing rows in realtime dashboard and webhook delivery failures. renewal check in 3 days. opened ticket #90077 :rotating_light:
Maya (CS): thanks Aisha. can you paste the last errors and confirm the Sparkline contact? we need a CS handoff and comms plan ASAP :eyes:
Ben (Support): errors below, traces attached by ops-bot
```
2025-05-14T08:44:12Z ERROR Auth: 401 Unauthorized - token refresh rejected (tenant: sparkline)
2025-05-14T08:45:01Z WARN Webhook: 502 Bad Gateway -> retries exhausted
Missing rows: index ingestion lag > 12m
TraceID: trc-spark-90077
```
Contact: claire@sparkline.ai (Head of Analytics). They've retried onboarding flows; reported data gaps on a pilot demo earlier. ops-bot: traces -> https://internal.redwood/logs/90077, metrics -> https://dash.redwood/sparkline/90077 :link:
Maya (CS): triage suggestion: 1) 10-15m quick sync today for consent + scope 2) hands-on enablement tomorrow (token regen + verify webhook endpoint) 3) temporary mitigation: pause retries and start manual backfill/queueing job. If backfill fails, escalate to eng-oncall. Who can join enablement? :calendar:
Raj (Onboarding): I can run the enablement and own the runbook edits. available tomorrow 14:00 PT. I'll prepare a minimal permissions checklist and sample curl commands.
Aisha (Support): Claire can do a quick 15m call today at 11:30 PT. I'll begin token regen after consent and post secure link to creds.
Maya (CS): I'll send warm intro + invites now. Owners: @Raj (Onboarding) / @Aisha (Support) / @Ben (Support). Deliverables: customer summary after enablement, renewal risk update by EOD Friday.
Ben (Support): quick curl snippet for token regen I'll attach to the invite:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/auth/refresh \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <old-refresh>" \
 -d '{"tenant":"sparkline"}'
```
Maya (CS): also prep a short customer note: what we did, next steps, rollback plan. If manual backfill needed, include estimated completion window and whether it affects billing/usage.
eng-oncall: noted - if manual backfill job errors, ping me with traceID. I'll standby for escalation.
Maya (CS): action items assigned. I'll update the trial renewal health score after enablement and set a follow-up for Friday. Closing loop here unless new info :thumbsup:
